name: Golden A/S Customer
subtitle: Projects, documents, offers
promotionalText: Follow your Golden A/S projects, sign documents, decide on offers and reach our engineers — from your phone.
description:
Golden A/S Customer is the application for the owners, captains and technical managers of vessels whose electrical, automation and navigation systems are built or serviced by Golden Automation Systems (Golden A/S).

Access is by invitation from your Golden A/S project manager; the app is a companion to the Golden A/S customer portal.

With it you can:
• follow the progress of your projects and sub-projects, vessel by vessel
• review and approve drawings and documents submitted for owner approval, with comments
• sign field service reports and acceptance documents on the device
• see the offers issued to you and accept or decline them
• open support tickets for your vessels and follow their resolution
• read the project documentation and the service history of your equipment

Sign-in with password and authenticator code, or with Face ID / Touch ID and passkeys after the first sign-in. Your data stays on the Golden A/S portal and is never shared with third parties. Available in English, Greek, Italian, Ukrainian and Bulgarian.
whatsNew: New: notifications on your phone. After you sign in the app asks once for permission; with it you are told when an approval is asked, a new offer or document is ready, a report waits for your signature or a ticket is answered. A tap opens the right page. You can stop them in the settings of the phone.
reviewNotes:
1. SCREEN RECORDING
Attached in the Attachment field of this App Review Information section (GoldenCustomer_review_recording.mp4). Recorded on a physical iPhone with the demo account; it shows: launch from the home screen, sign-in with e-mail and password, Home (action centre with the vessels of the fleet), Sign, Offers, Tickets with a new support request created and opened, More, Project progress, Account (language, biometric unlock, passkeys, devices), Lock app and unlock with Face ID, and sign-out. The lists were empty when the recording was made; since then the demo account opens a demonstration fleet with invented data, so the reviewer finds reports to sign, documents to approve, offers and tickets at sign-in.

2. PURPOSE AND AUDIENCE
Golden A/S Customer is the companion app of the customer portal of Golden A/S (Golden Automation Systems), a marine electrical, automation and navigation systems integrator based in Piraeus, Greece. It is for the company's customers: owners, captains and technical managers of vessels whose systems Golden A/S builds or services. It lets them follow their projects vessel by vessel, review and approve drawings and documents sent for owner approval, sign field service reports and acceptance documents on the device, see and answer the offers issued to them, and open and follow support tickets. It replaces e-mail and paper for these approvals and signatures.

3. ACCESS
Sign in with the demo account given in the App Review Information section (a demonstration account: it opens an invented fleet with invented data only, what is done there stays on the device; no authenticator code is needed). Tabs: Home, Sign, Offers, Tickets, More. On Sign, open a document to see the PDF and the Review / Sign buttons. The app has no account registration: a customer account is created by Golden A/S by invitation when a project starts, so there is no in-app account creation. A customer who wants the account closed or the data deleted asks Golden A/S through the contact given in the privacy policy; the account is then disabled by the company.

4. EXTERNAL SERVICES
The app talks only to Golden A/S's own server (https://www.goldensas.com) over HTTPS. No third-party analytics, advertising, payment or AI service is used. Sign-in uses the accounts of the Golden A/S customer portal, with optional authenticator (TOTP) and passkeys; Face ID / Touch ID is used on the device only. The app registers with Apple Push Notification service for notifications; no other notification service is used.

5. REGIONS
The app works the same in all regions. Languages: English, Greek, Italian, Ukrainian, Bulgarian.

6. REGULATED CONTENT
None. The app contains no third-party protected material, no purchases and no paid content: offers shown in the app are commercial offers for marine engineering work, accepted or declined as a business decision and invoiced outside the app. Documents belong to Golden A/S and its customers and are processed under the privacy policy: https://www.goldenas.com.gr/privacy.html

USER CONTENT
Comments and tickets are exchanged only between a customer and Golden A/S staff; there is no public content.

BUSINESS MODEL
The app is free and is a service for existing customers of Golden A/S. It is published on the App Store because the customers are many separate companies and individuals (owners and crews) who are not part of one organisation. Push notifications (new in this version): after sign-in the app asks for the notification permission; notifications are sent by our server for the user's own approvals, documents and reminders. The app works fully without the permission.
